transcript: Speaker A: These are headphones. I am wearing headphones. Wearing means putting on my body. I put them on my ears. I am listening carefully. Carefully means with attention. I focus on the sound. I am increasing the volume. Increasing means making more. The sound becomes louder. I am enjoying the music. Enjoying means feeling happy. I like the music. I am removing the headphones. Removing means taking off. I take them off my ears.
